Make the two identities entirely different in eye shape, nose, chin, hat, hair and facial hair, and different from the reference identities. Both front-facing, head and shoulders, same scale and visual density as original NES portraits. Sparse expressive original NES/Famicom face drawing with only BLACK #000000, WHITE #FFFFFF, ORANGE #F7A247, BROWN #9E4100. No extra colors, gray, gradients, antialiasing, texture, lighting effects, modern rich pixelart, letters, captions, logos, decorative borders or grid lines. Keep full hats, faces and shoulders completely inside their cells, with generous pure-black outside margins and a wide pure-black central gutter. Original game's white face/hat backing is fine inside each portrait. Sheet overall landscape aspect8:5, two equal portrait cells. Maintain a flat simple 1980s game appearance.
identity_basis: Two independently authored faces for Beigong Boyu and Li Wenhou; not historical likenesses; no inherited officer portrait.
